objective: Add two AREALS fine-tuning seeds to the existing nine-angle DoubleDelta measurement-conditioned baseline.
scope: Independent fine-tuning seeds conditional on one shared geometry-pretrained checkpoint; no pretraining-seed replication.
selection: Unchanged original rule: mean nRMSE over sensors-20, sensors-500 and patch-64-0.60 on the same four development physical geometries (36 cases).
evaluation: Original saved observations, all eight settings; both added seeds evaluated without configuration changes.
prior_test_exposure: Seed-0 AREALS and all GABI test results were known before this extension. Seeds 1 and 2 and the unchanged protocol are fixed before their execution.
statistics: Report each seed, arithmetic mean and sample SD across seeds. Compare method seed means; bootstrap physical geometries 10000 times, retaining all angles and all seeds. Intervals are conditional on these trained models; numeric seed labels do not imply paired training randomness across methods.
